mapper.select: SELECT AS level, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM ads_user_rfm p GROUP BY level ORDER BY userCount DESC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, u.gender AS gender, u.age AS age, u.province AS province, s.segment_name AS segmentName, p.rfm_group_name AS rfmGroupName, AS level, p.recency_days AS recencyDays, p.total_order_count AS orderCount, p.total_payment_amount AS totalPaymentAmount FROM ads_user_rfm p JOIN ecommerce_user u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN user_segment s ON s.user_id = u.id
= #{level}
ORDER BY p.recency_days ${orderDir == 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'}, p.total_payment_amount DESC
ORDER BY p.total_order_count ${orderDir == 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'}, p.recency_days DESC
ORDER BY p.total_payment_amount ${orderDir == 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'}, p.recency_days DESC
ORDER BY p.recency_days DESC, p.total_payment_amount DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT MAX(data_version) AS dataVersion, MAX(calculated_at) AS calculatedAt FROM ads_user_rfm
